description: This file defines the interface for internal control server functionalities within the Rialto media server, including factory creation, control commands, and server state management.

classes.name: IControlServerInternal
classes.description: Interface for controlling Rialto server internal operations, including setting application state, acknowledging pings, and handling health checks.

classes.name: IControlServerInternalFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating instances of IControlServerInternal.

methods.name: createControlServerInternal
methods.description: Creates a new instance of IControlServerInternal with specified control ID and client callback object.

methods.name: setApplicationState
methods.description: Informs the connected Rialto client about a change in the server's application state.

methods.name: ack
methods.description: Acknowledges receipt of a ping request with the specified ID.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Sends a ping notification to check system health, with a heartbeat handler for managing the response.
